## Summary

Describe the smallest change and the user-visible behavior it addresses.

## Scope and authorization

- [ ] This change stays within the declared project scope.
- [ ] It does not include credentials, private paths, local state, task IDs, or internal reports.
- [ ] It does not perform GitHub publication or external automation.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests were run with bytecode writes disabled.
- [ ] Storage or host claims are limited to evidence actually obtained.
- [ ] Known failures and unverified hosts are stated.

## Evidence

List commands, results, and any remaining risk. Redact sensitive output.
